issue.title: P3505R4 and P2497R0 should not bump the same feature-test macro

discussion.p:
It is mentioned in that the paper should be implemented as a defect report against C++17. However, bumps `__cpp_lib_to_chars`, while already bumped the same feature-test macro in C++26, and currently there is no way to indicating that the implementation has implemented but not .
looks like a pure new feature which eases use of result types and thus doesn't seem suitable for DR. Additionally, libc++ has fully implemented the functional changes in but can't bump the FTM because libc++ still lacks long double support in <charconv>. So, maybe it would be better to make use another FTM for indicating .
